sources.label: Q2 FY27 call · 5 Nov 2026 (exchange summary of transcript filing)

trail.quote: we are positive to say that we will start seeing growth in FY27.
we can definitely look at growth, at nearly late-stage single digit or early-stage double digit
we are looking at a positive trajectory, and in the lower single digit as indicated earlier.

claims.note: Guidance was walked down twice in six months, from high-single or low-double digits to low single digits, while H1 came in at about −10%. Even +2% for FY27 needs H2 to grow about 17% YoY.

trail.quote: there will be a sequential growth in quarter 4 over what we have seen in quarter 3.

claims.delivered: Q4 FY26 sales ₹1,565 cr vs Q3 ₹1,376 cr (+13.7% QoQ), still −12.4% YoY.
claims.note: Delivered sequentially, but the recovery stalled at the same ~₹1,700 cr run-rate for the next two quarters.

trail.quote: we would still hold ourselves for the year what we have started the year with 25% to 26.

claims.delivered: FY26 EBITDA ₹1,732 cr on ₹6,714 cr sales = 25.8%.

trail.quote: maintain our long-term GP margin guidance between 50% to 52%, and we continue to move with that.
we said we would continue to manage and maintain the average gross margin of last year.
we will try and maintain with the optimization that the company is trying to do

claims.delivered: Q2 FY27 gross margin 49% (per Q2 transcript filing); EBITDA margin fell to 14% from 29% a year ago.
claims.note: Management said in August it would 'try and maintain' the targeted gross margin. One quarter later it was below the long-term 50–52% floor.

claims.topic: CSM exports turn positive in FY27

trail.quote: We are pretty confident it will turn positive in FY27.
somewhere around $ 1-1.2 billion which is already the order book position

claims.delivered: Q2 FY27 AgChem exports −18% YoY (per Q2 transcript filing).
claims.note: The $1–1.2 bn order book has not converted into revenue. Exports are the swing factor for the whole year.

trail.quote: We expect the domestic growth to be back on track from FY27 onwards.

claims.delivered: Q2 FY27 domestic agri +19% YoY (per Q2 transcript filing).
claims.note: The only growth engine that is working, but domestic is the smaller half of the business.

trail.quote: the first Indian innovation in Ag-chem, Pioxaniliprole, will be commercialised in the coming financial year.

claims.delivered: Launched as 'Pioxazon' in Q2 FY27 (per Q2 transcript filing).

trail.quote: We expect FY27 and thereafter ETR to inch upto 24%.
We expect ETR for FY27 to be around 24%.

claims.delivered: Effective tax 24% in Q1 FY27, 34% in Q2 FY27.
claims.note: A 34% ETR on a smaller profit base cuts PAT further. Ask whether this is a mix effect or one-off.

trail.quote: So broadly, it will be about INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore.
we should have INR 700 to INR 800 crore of capex both at the manufacturing level

claims.delivered: ≈₹570 cr in H1 (derived: Δ fixed assets + Δ CWIP + H1 depreciation from the Sep-26 balance sheet).
claims.note: Capex guidance went up while revenue guidance went down, so spending continues into a downturn.

trail.quote: we are looking to target to get this to the next two to three years, a INR 500-INR 600 crore business

claims.delivered: Segment revenue is reported in the results filing; not yet broken out in this snapshot's parsed data.
claims.note: Ask for the H1 pharma run-rate on the next call. Reaching ₹500–600 cr needs several times the current scale.

trail.quote: we expect to improve this as the market scenarios normalize in the coming quarters.

claims.delivered: Working-capital days 120 in FY26 vs 67 in FY25; debtor days 88 vs 64.
claims.note: Cash from operations fell to ₹474 cr in FY26 from ₹1,413 cr.

trail.quote: we are quite confident of achieving the twice the market growth

claims.delivered: Q1 FY27 sales ₹946 cr, +40.5% YoY. Q2 numbers filed last night; extraction pending in this snapshot.
claims.note: Revenue growth has never been the problem. The question is what it costs in cash.

claims.topic: Turn cash-positive by end of FY27

trail.quote: that by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive, we are pretty confident on that.

claims.delivered: Operating cash flow −₹82 cr in FY25 and −₹600 cr in FY26; CFO/EBITDA −80% in FY26.
claims.note: To deliver, FY27 operating cash flow has to swing by more than ₹600 cr, while revenue grows about 30%. The Q2 auditor review flags restated prior-period errors.

trail.quote: we will be able to do the turnaround by end of this year in terms of receivables from the metering business.

claims.delivered: Debtor days 154 (FY26), with working-capital days up from 64 to 133 over three years.

claims.topic: Margins normalise in a couple of quarters

trail.quote: We expect this could take a couple of quarters for profitability to normalize
It is going to be a tough year.

claims.delivered: Q1 FY27 OPM 15.6% vs 16.8% a year ago; PAT −24% YoY.
claims.note: Check against Q2 once the filing is parsed.

claims.topic: OSAT + PCB revenue ₹450–500 cr in FY27

trail.quote: INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time

claims.delivered: Commercial booking expected from Q3/Q4. On 12 Nov, Vishay agreed to take 49% of Kaynes Semicon.
claims.note: The Vishay JV de-risks OSAT demand but dilutes ownership of the most valuable option.

claims.topic: Capex ~₹850 cr; 'cash is not a constraint'

trail.quote: We said we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB
Cash is not a constraint here.

claims.delivered: FY26 free cash flow −₹1,841 cr, funded by ₹1,580 cr of financing inflows (QIP + debt).
claims.note: Saying cash is not a constraint is only true while equity markets stay open. Kaynes has raised two QIPs since 2023.
